Tripura Blockade Disrupts Train and Vehicle Traffic

Train services and vehicular movement in Tripura have been disrupted as a blockade by surrendered militants entered its second day. The protest has affected transportation across the state. Details regarding the specific demands of the surrendered militants or the duration of the blockade were not provided in the coverage.
